parsed.title: Searching Algorithms and Hash Tables
parsed.description: An 8-week intermediate course for university students, exploring fundamental and advanced searching techniques. The course covers sequential and interval search algorithms, transitions to the concept of O(1) search with hash tables, and provides a deep dive into hash function design and collision resolution strategies.

sections.title: Module 1: Fundamentals of Searching Algorithms
topics: Course Introduction: The Importance of Efficient Data Retrieval
Defining Searching Algorithms
Core Categories: Sequential Search vs. Interval Search

sections.title: Module 2: Sequential Search
topics: The Linear Search Algorithm: Approach and Implementation
Time Complexity Analysis of Linear Search: O(n)

sections.title: Module 3: Interval Search Algorithms for Sorted Data
topics: Binary Search: The Divide and Conquer Approach
Implementing Binary Search: Recursive vs. Iterative
Time Complexity Analysis of Binary Search: O(log n)
Jump Search: Leaping Through Sorted Arrays
Interpolation Search: An Improvement on Binary Search
Comparative Analysis: When to Use Binary, Jump, or Interpolation Search

sections.title: Module 4: Introduction to Hashing and Hash Tables
topics: The Quest for O(1) Search: Beyond Comparison-Based Algorithms
Direct-Address Tables: The Ideal but Impractical Concept
Introducing Hash Tables: A Practical Solution for Fast Lookups
Core Components: Keys, Hash Functions, and Slots
The Collision Problem: When Two Keys Map to the Same Slot

sections.title: Module 5: Designing Effective Hash Functions
topics: Properties of a Good Hash Function: Simple Uniform Hashing
Prerequisite: Interpreting Keys as Natural Numbers
The Division Method
The Multiplication Method
Heuristic Methods: Digit Extraction and Mid-Square
Heuristic Methods: Folding and Rotation
The Pseudo-Random Method

sections.title: Module 6: Collision Resolution Strategies
topics: Strategy 1: Collision Resolution by Chaining
Strategy 2: Open Addressing - The General Concept
Open Addressing Technique: Linear Probing
Evaluating Linear Probing: The Primary Clustering Problem
Open Addressing Technique: Quadratic Probing
Evaluating Quadratic Probing: The Secondary Clustering Problem
Open Addressing Technique: Double Hashing
Comparing Chaining and Open Addressing

sections.title: Module 7: Advanced Hashing and Course Summary
topics: Bucket Hashing: A Hybrid Approach
Summary: Choosing the Right Search Algorithm and Hashing Strategy
Course Review and Final Assessment
